blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Two police officers were arrested by their colleagues at a border control checkpoint after allegedly shooting a man Monday evening in Sitio Lumboy, Barangay Indahag here. A concerned citizen alerted Police Station 2 at 9:54 p.m. about gunfire in the area, which prompted a citywide flash alarm. The male victim sustained a gunshot wound to his upper thigh. Bystanders assisted him before a barangay ambulance transported him to Maria Reyna Xavier University Hospital, where he remains in stable condition.
